description: Private AI that runs entirely on your Mac: a native SwiftUI app on its own Swift + Metal inference engine. Streams MoE experts from SSD (Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B in ~1.5 GB), runs GGUF through in-process llama.cpp, and serves an OpenAI-compatible local API.
